Interpret the AST exactly: const is a literal; var reads event.status, event.amount, state.x or state.y. eq/ne/ge/gt/le/lt compare two arguments without coercion; all/any combine boolean arguments; not negates one. For each event, evaluate rule and precondition on the current state; execute only when both are true. Otherwise keep state unchanged. add increases source by amount; scale multiplies source by amount; transfer simultaneously subtracts from source and adds to destination; swap exchanges source and destination simultaneously. Signed balances are allowed unless the stated precondition forbids them. Ignore annotation. Execute events in given sequence.
Return JSON {after: final_state} only.
